why_history_untrustworthy: The baseline has only two events, 2025-05-12 and 2025-02-10, both over sixteen months old. EDGAR shows Ispire has filed no 8-K carrying item 2.02 since 2025-05-12 (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001948455&type=8-K) — the last four earnings prints (FY25 Q4 in Sept 2025, and FY26 Q1/Q2/Q3) are simply absent from the 8-K 2.02 path the builder uses. So the two moves are genuine earnings reactions but the sample is a stale, non-representative third of the recent record, and both happened to be negative (up_count 0/2). Do not read a 0/2 down-bias as a base rate.
where_to_look: The financing trail. $84m cap at $1.42 with a 20-day average volume of 18,190 shares — roughly $26k a day of turnover, so this is uninvestable at any size and the share count is the thing that moves. Check EDGAR for S-3 / 424B5 prospectus supplements, ATM usage and the share count on the 10-K cover against the last 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001948455&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40

Receivables and any going-concern language in the FY2026 10-K. Ispire's historic problem has been collection on overseas distributor receivables; a going-concern paragraph or a large bad-debt provision would be the single largest unpriced item and it lives in the 10-K, which is normally filed the same day as or within days of the release.

Nasdaq listing compliance. The stock is at $1.42, 61% below its 52-week high; any minimum-bid-price notice or compliance-plan disclosure would be an 8-K item 3.01 and was not found in the recent 8-K list, so its absence is itself worth confirming.

The Jincheng Pharma nicotine-pouch joint venture announced 2026-05-12 and the 2026-08-17 appointment of Steven Przybyla as President (8-K items 5.02/7.01) — the FY26 release is the first time either gets a financial framing.
